parameters.content:
## Speed-to-Lead Lite
Every new lead from your website form gets a personal AI-written email with your booking link within a minute. AI scores the lead 1-10, it is logged to Google Sheets, and you get an email when a hot lead comes in.

**Setup (about 10 minutes)**
1. Make a Google Sheet with a tab `Leads` and these headers in row 1: received_at, lead_id, name, email, phone, source, message, score, temperature, summary, status, notes
2. Open **Settings**: business details, booking link, your email, sheet URL.
3. Connect credentials: OpenAI, Google Sheets, Gmail (open each node once so the credential attaches).
4. Point your website form at the **New lead (webhook)** URL, or share the built-in form's URL.
5. Activate.

### Full version adds
- Text / WhatsApp reply (Twilio) as well as email
- Follow-ups after 24h and 72h if the lead goes quiet
- Stops follow-ups when they book (Cal.com / Calendly) or text back, and forwards replies to you
- Duplicate check (returning leads alert you instead of a second reply)
- Text alert to your phone on hot leads

**Want it installed for you?** I set up the full version on your own accounts. Message me through my n8n Creator profile.
